description: Check whether a given recipient is on the account-wide (or tenant-scoped) suppression list. Always returns `email`, `suppressed`, `scope`, `reason` and `since`; a clean address is `suppressed: false` (HTTP 200, not a 404). Use to short-circuit sends to addresses that have previously bounced, complained, or unsubscribed.

tenant_id.description: Scope the check to a specific tenant.

name: truncus_check_suppression
title: Check if an email is suppressed
